coordinates: Box center and size, divided by original image width/height respectively.

notes.encoding: Space-separated numeric values formatted with %g; one instance per line, trailing newline. This JSON file describes the text layout; the producer does not emit JSON.
notes.classes: Zero-based model class index. Class meanings require the producing model class-name mapping, which is not embedded.
notes.confidence: Last column is present only when save_conf is enabled; disabled by default.
notes.files: Appends to the output text file. No write when no detections exist; an existing file is not cleared.
notes.metadata: No image dimensions, image path or class names in each row. Keep source-image association externally.
notes.rounding: Original-image corner coordinates are rounded before conversion to the normalized text representation.
notes.order: Detection rows are traversed in reverse order.
